title.en: Corruption, Drug Trafficking and Other Serious Crimes (Confiscation of Benefits) (Prescribed International Organisations) Regulations 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Corruption, Drug Trafficking and Other Serious Crimes (Confiscation of Benefits) (Prescribed International Organisations) Regulations 2019 and come into operation on 1 April 2019.

2. The Egmont Group of Financial Intelligence Units is a prescribed international organisation for the purposes of the definition of “international arrangement” in section 48(3) of the Act.
[S 488/2023 wef 31/12/2021]
